E8_singlet_FD_flatness.generic_nonzero_CEG_obstruction: If k1 or k2 !=0, F_{G_i}=k_i C E=0. If E=0, ell=(1,1,0) on D=0 forces C=0 because other remaining ell charges are >=0. Hence C=S13=0 in ALL simultaneous F/D-flat vacua (canonical positive Kahler, zero FI).
E8_singlet_FD_flatness.two_bilinears_proof: m !=0 => A=0 from F_B; n !=0 => E=0 from F_D; then B=0 from F_A. Remaining D_ell>=0 forces C,D,F,G,H=0. No other singlet field remains.
E8_singlet_FD_flatness.exception: A missing κ, noncanonical Kähler, FI shifts, additional charged fields/neutral mediators, or nonperturbative/source terms can evade these conditional statements.
E8_singlet_FD_flatness.scope: All monomials enumerate only the eight *specified* charged Spin10 singlets, gauge U1^3 charges, and polynomial degrees <=3. Gauge allowance does NOT prove a physical term is generated.

compact_Yukawa_adjoint_tradeoff.cohomological_argument: With unbroken Lie algebra g globally fixed by flat holonomy and no defect projection, H1(M;adP_invariants)=g tensor H1(M), dimension 45*3. Nonzero wedge of three degree-one classes requires dimension H1>=3.
compact_Yukawa_adjoint_tradeoff.limitation: Flux, singular boundary conditions, superpotentials and nontrivial adjoint holonomy could lift/projection these modes; any such choice must also preserve desired Spin10 gauge group and Yukawa classes.

adjoint_SU5_mass_consistency.conditional_no_go: Embedding a light triplet and octet into the SAME renormalizable 24F with only 24H mass splitting forces a light (3,2)+conj fermion. This violates the effective calculation placing all other 24F components at MU.
adjoint_SU5_mass_consistency.escape: Different fermion representations, higher dimensional 24F²24H² terms, more Higgs irreps or nontrivial multiplet mixing can break the exact relation.
adjoint_SU5_mass_consistency.limitation: The two triplets and one octet are imported benchmark choices, not independently observed masses, and complex mixing matrices can change eigenvalue mass relations.

anisotropic_Einstein_relational_clock.exact_relational_observables: a_i(phi)=exp(p_i phi/sigma), independent of t or n labeling
anisotropic_Einstein_relational_clock.coordinate_exchange_clock: n=ln(t), lapse N(n)=dt/dn=exp(n); counting n as unit proper-time steps would be incorrect
anisotropic_Einstein_relational_clock.limitation: Classical Bianchi-I minisuperspace solution, not quantum gravity, not 3+1 local Dirac algebra or emergent metric derivation.

single_photon_local_SSR.resource_diagnosis: Local operations commuting with local particle number cannot access relative |01><10| coherence without a reference/ancilla that lifts local SSR. A shared coherent phase reference is an additional physical resource.
single_photon_local_SSR.limitation: Conditional on a strict local number superselection rule and no nonlocal/shared phase resources. Bell violation of single-photon states IS possible with suitable references or other allowed protocols; this is not a universal no-go.

selective_topological_cubic_alignment.source_cohomology: H1(T3 minus open ball, boundary; Z)=Z3
selective_topological_cubic_alignment.constructive_alignment: Nonzero family Yukawa and zero dangerous S13*S34*S14conj loop cup can coexist at cohomology level if the singlet three classes are linearly dependent but the family triple is independent.
selective_topological_cubic_alignment.non_generic_warning: det(singlet)=0 is a codimension-one relation among wavefunction cohomology classes over R; quantized integral data may protect it, but no physical dynamics selecting these classes is supplied.
selective_topological_cubic_alignment.separation_limit: All wavefunction triples shown are abstract integral cohomology assignments, not solutions of a single E8 Higgs-bundle/Dirac localization problem with all charges and M2 corrections.
